customers.evidence: We put our customers and people first

employees.evidence: We will elevate our people practices to ensure our people feel welcomed, valued, and part of the McDonald’s community

dei.evidence: We open our doors to everyone

safety.evidence: fostering a safe, respectful and inclusive workplace

result.analyst_notes: Warm, aspirational, first-person plural voice throughout. Values appear as short headline statements, with customers listed first under 'Serve'. Commitments are largely unhedged ('we are committed to'). Much of the text is mission and feel-good branding rather than measurable pledges. Environment, shareholders and innovation are absent.
